contexts.title: Makerspace Operations
contexts.definition: Operational vocabulary shared by makerspaces, hackerspaces, fab labs and tool libraries: the space itself, its members, shared equipment, the tool badges that gate it, members' authorizations, door and tool access events, equipment reservations and usage sessions, and tool lending.

concepts.definition: A community-operated shared workshop (hackerspace, fab lab, library or school lab, tool library, repair cafe) where people use common tools and machines to make or repair things. Described as an organization with a public address, access and membership model, fabrication capabilities and verification provenance.

fields.name: publicAccess
fields.description: Can a non-member use the space by any route

fields.name: capabilities
fields.description: Fabrication capabilities, e.g. laser_cutting, cnc_router, welding_mig_tig

fields.name: spaceApiUrl
fields.description: SpaceAPI endpoint giving live open/closed state

fields.name: issuesBadges
fields.description: Signs Open Badges 3.0 credentials for its members

fields.name: acceptsBadges
fields.description: Honours credentials issued by recognised spaces

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields from the Makerspace Network space record JSON Schema (a profile of Open Know-Where ManufacturingFacility, crosswalked to SpaceAPI and fablabs.io), whose enums are in data/schema/enums.json. Corroborated by the operator's own Drupal site (membership types, tool lending, badge issuing) and the access-control apps.

concepts.definition: A person's account at a shared community workshop: the identity the door and tool readers recognise, the membership plan and status that decide whether they may enter, and the dates and waiver that bound it. Also covers a non-member account held only for access cards.

fields.name: identifier
fields.description: Stable account UUID shared with access-control systems

fields.name: accessCardSerial
fields.description: RFID card serial presented at readers

fields.name: makerspace
fields.description: The space the membership is with

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Identity fields (uuid, card_serial, first_name, last_name, access) agree across the card-reader payload model, the offline access-control store (adds email) and the Drupal user/profile entities (membership type, end date and reason, payment status, waiver, emergency contact). Status values generalised from the Drupal membership workflow.

concepts.definition: A shared tool or machine in a community workshop that members use, reserve or borrow, often gated behind a training badge and wired to a card reader. Distinguished from general assets by its fabrication capability, hazard band, required badges and reservation rules.

fields.name: capability
fields.description: Fabrication capability vocabulary value, e.g. laser_cutting

fields.name: requiredBadges
fields.description: Badges a member must hold to use it

fields.name: lendable
fields.description: Can leave the space on loan

fields.name: readerDeviceId
fields.description: Card reader or activator controlling power to it

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Brand, model, count, capability and notes from the Makerspace Network space record equipment[] (OKW ManufacturingEquipment). Status, location, hazard band, required badges, reservation limits, serial, value and useful life from the Drupal item and library_item node types; reader/activator device ids from the offline access-control store; the equipment id is what the station-login and 3D-printer auth plugins pass to the site API.

concepts.definition: A named, versioned qualification that a shared workshop requires before someone may operate a particular machine or class of machines: its competency checklist, hazard class, prerequisites and how it is assessed (training, checkout, class). It is the definition; a person holding it is recorded separately.

fields.name: identifier
fields.description: Stable machine id of the badge

fields.name: checkoutRequirement
fields.description: Whether a supervised checkout or class is needed

fields.name: alignedAchievement
fields.description: Network achievement definition this local badge aligns to

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Competencies, excludes, site-specific, hazard class, version and status from the Makerspace Network achievement JSON Schema (aligned to Open Badges 3.0 Achievement) and its alignment schema; checklist, prerequisites, checkout requirement and minutes, access-control flag and text id from the Drupal badges taxonomy. Card-reader and access-control payloads name it as badge_name/permission.

concepts.definition: The record that one person holds a specific tool badge at a shared workshop, so card readers and machines let them operate it. Carries who granted it after which training, its lifecycle (pending, active, suspended, expired) and, when exported, the signed credential that lets another space honour it.

fields.name: grantedBy
fields.description: The facilitator or issuer who signed off

fields.name: issuerId
fields.description: Issuing space, as did:web or HTTPS profile

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Member, badge and status from the Drupal badge_request node (pending/active/suspended/expired/rejected, class completed date); uuid + permission + access boolean from the card system's BadgePermission payload; user-tool assignments in the offline access-control store; validUntil, issuer and status list from Open Badges 3.0 AchievementCredential as adopted by the Makerspace Network reciprocity design.

concepts.definition: One attempt to get through a door or power up a machine at a shared workshop: who presented which card or identifier at which reader, which permission was checked, and whether it was granted. Also covers a guest checked in by a hosting member.

fields.name: readerId
fields.description: Door or tool reader that asked

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Reader, user and tools from the card system's BadgeAuthorization/BadgeLog and AuthRequest payloads (card serial or user id + badge name); permission, result, method, source, note and guest host from the Drupal access_control_log ECK entity (access_control_request and guest_checkin bundles); door and timestamp from the offline lobby presence store.

concepts.definition: A borrowing of a shared tool to take away from a workshop or tool library: who borrowed which item, when it is due, renewals, the condition inspection on return, and any late, damage or replacement charges. Distinct from an on-site reservation.

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: From the Drupal lending_library library_transaction ECK entity (also the basis of the lattice-evals makerspace-retrofit-01 scenario); the Makerspace Network space record's operations.tool_lending flag marks which spaces run one. Only one operational system implements it so far.

concepts.definition: A booked time window on one shared machine at a workshop, held by a member for a stated purpose (personal work, badge checkout, class, production). Shown at the machine's station so walk-up users see who has it next.

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Drupal reservation node (asset, time range, purpose, status, notes) and the station-login client that reads asset/range/name/note/purpose/status from the site's upcoming-reservations-per-equipment API; the equipment record carries reservable and max hours.

concepts.definition: A period during which one identified member actually runs a shared machine, opened when they authenticate at the machine and closed when they log out or the job ends. Records duration and consumables used so time and material can be billed.

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Station-login client (session start/end/duration per equipment, material usage entry) and the 3D-printer auth plugin (member identified by email against a badge permission, authorized flag, print time, cancel reason, auth timeout), both against the site's equipment and materials APIs.

sources.title: Makerspace Network directory: space records
sources.recordDescription: One makerspace, hackerspace, fab lab or comparable shared workshop, with address, access and membership model, capabilities and verification provenance.
sources.note: One JSON file per space under data/spaces/ (the listing's download_url gives each record), validated by https://makerspace.network/schema/space/0.1.0. Field names are dotted JSON paths. 21 Connecticut records as of 2026-10-13; schema is multi-state via region_ids.

sources.title: Makerspace Network achievement definitions
sources.recordDescription: One versioned, transferable tool-competence definition (e.g. table saw operator) that a space's local badge aligns to via Open Badges 3.0.
sources.note: index.json lists id, version, name, status, url; the full record is at <url>.json (e.g. /achievements/table-saw-operator/v1.json) with the remaining fields. One draft definition as of 2026-10-13.

fields.conversion: the definition URL is what a local badge's alignment points at
